# [0.6.0](https://github.com/OniVe/opencode-websearch-deepseek/compare/v0.5.0...v0.6.0) (2026-10-18)


* feat!: enable native search by default ([2fc9af9](https://github.com/OniVe/opencode-websearch-deepseek/commit/2fc9af945b647617bf8db54874716a3a67929155))


### BREAKING CHANGES

* DeepSeek users without an explicit `searchApi` now get
structured search results instead of a synthesized answer. Set
`searchApi: "messages"` to restore the previous behavior.
